counties.county_housing_authority: Sonoma County Community Development Commission
counties.notes: Active wildfire recovery / rebuild-related housing funds may apply

counties.county_housing_authority: Napa County Housing Authority
El Dorado County Health and Human Services Agency, Housing Division
counties.notes: Tahoe Basin projects may fall under separate TRPA jurisdiction rules, flag if relevant

counties.county_housing_authority: Solano County Department of Health and Social Services / Housing Authority of the County of Solano
Yolo County Housing
counties.notes: West Sacramento has its own active redevelopment successor agency programs

counties.county_housing_authority: Contra Costa County Department of Conservation and Development
Alameda County Housing and Community Development Department
counties.notes: Oakland and Berkeley run substantial independent local programs, treat as near-county-level in depth

counties.county_housing_authority: San Joaquin County Community Development Department
San Mateo County Department of Housing
counties.notes: Home For All San Mateo County initiative is a useful index of local programs Priority cities expanded 2026-11-07 at user request to add Menlo Park, East Palo Alto, Burlingame and San Carlos (high-income or subsidy-active cities); edit as needed.

counties.county_housing_authority: Marin County Community Development Agency / Housing Authority of the County of Marin
Placer County Health and Human Services, Housing and Community Development Division
Orange County Housing and Community Development (OC Community Resources) and Orange County Housing Authority (OCHA)
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-06 at user request. Priority cities are the five largest by population; edit as needed. Orange County Housing Finance Trust (JPA of County and cities) is a regional source.

counties.county_housing_authority: County of San Diego Housing and Community Development Services (HCDS) and Housing Authority of the County of San Diego (HACSD); the City of San Diego has its own San Diego Housing Commission (SDHC)
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-06 at user request. Priority cities are the five largest by population; edit as needed. Regional Task Force on Homelessness (RTFH) is the CoC (CA-601).

counties.county_housing_authority: County of Santa Clara Office of Supportive Housing (OSH) administers County housing funds including 2016 Measure A; Santa Clara County Housing Authority (SCCHA) is the PHA for the county except where the City of San Jose contracts with it
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the five largest by population; edit as needed. The CoC is CA-500 (San Jose/Santa Clara City and County), led by OSH and Destination: Home.

counties.county_housing_authority: San Benito County Resource Management Agency (Planning) with the Housing Authority of the County of San Benito (PHA)
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the largest or most development-active; edit as needed. Small county; check the Hollister HOME and CDBG programs and the Community Foundation for San Benito County.

counties.county_housing_authority: County of Santa Cruz Housing for Health Division and Community Development and Infrastructure Department; Housing Authority of the County of Santa Cruz (PHA, MTW cohort)
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the largest or most development-active; edit as needed. Measure Q 2024 transportation tax has no housing component; the County Affordable Housing Fund and the Housing Trust Fund with Housing Trust Silicon Valley are the local sources; CoC CA-508.

counties.county_housing_authority: County of Ventura Executive Office, Community Development and Housing; Area Housing Authority of the County of Ventura (PHA for unincorporated and most cities except Oxnard, Port Hueneme, Santa Paula and San Buenaventura, which have their own)
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the largest or most development-active; edit as needed. County Housing Trust Fund Ventura County (nonprofit) and the County Homeless Services; CoC CA-611.

counties.county_housing_authority: County of Fresno Department of Public Works and Planning, Community Development Division; Fresno Housing (joint Housing Authorities of the City and County of Fresno, MTW cohort)
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the largest or most development-active; edit as needed. City of Fresno runs its own large housing programs (Pass 3); CoC CA-514 Fresno-Madera.

counties.county_housing_authority: Madera County Community and Economic Development Department; Housing Authority of the City of Madera (serves the county)
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the largest or most development-active; edit as needed. Non-entitlement county for CDBG and HOME; shares CoC CA-514 with Fresno.

counties.county_housing_authority: Community Development Commission of Mendocino County (housing authority and County housing programs)
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the largest or most development-active; edit as needed. Non-entitlement county; Measure B behavioral health facilities tax; CoC CA-509.

counties.county_housing_authority: Merced County Community and Economic Development Department; Housing Authority of the County of Merced
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the largest or most development-active; edit as needed. Non-entitlement county (Merced city is an entitlement); UC Merced workforce housing demand; CoC CA-520.

counties.county_housing_authority: County of Monterey Housing and Community Development Department (Housing Division); Housing Authority of the County of Monterey
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the largest or most development-active; edit as needed. Fort Ord Reuse Authority land, Monterey County Housing Trust Fund and inclusionary ordinance; CoC CA-506 (Coalition of Homeless Services Providers, with San Benito).

counties.county_housing_authority: Nevada County Housing and Community Services Agency (Housing and Child Support Services); Regional Housing Authority (Sutter, Yuba, Nevada and Colusa counties) is the PHA
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the largest or most development-active; edit as needed. Non-entitlement county; Truckee has its own workforce housing programs and Tahoe-Truckee partnerships; CoC CA-531.

counties.county_housing_authority: Riverside County Housing and Workforce Solutions (HWS); Housing Authority of the County of Riverside (HACR)
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the largest or most development-active; edit as needed. Large Urban County entitlement with its own NOFAs and Housing Successor funds; Coachella Valley cities run separate programs (Pass 3); CoC CA-608.

counties.county_housing_authority: County of San Luis Obispo Planning and Building, Housing and Economic Development Division; Housing Authority of San Luis Obispo (HASLO) is the PHA and a developer
counties.notes: Added 2026-11-07 at user request. Priority cities are the largest or most development-active; edit as needed. County Title 29 Affordable Housing Fund (in-lieu and impact fees) and inclusionary ordinance; CoC CA-614.
